sections.title: NLP Systems ClickMasters Builds
sections.description: Domain-specific NLP solutions for every industry.

blocks.heading: Document Information Extraction
paragraphs: Converting unstructured document text into structured, machine-readable data — the NLP application with the widest commercial value:

Contract and legal document extraction: NLP extracting structured data from contracts — parties, effective dates, termination rights, payment terms, liability caps, indemnification scope, IP assignment, and renewal provisions — from the diverse formats and clause structures that real-world contracts contain. For organizations managing thousands of contracts, this NLP application replaces manual legal review with automated extraction that catches every instance of a clause rather than the sample a human reviewer has time to examine.

Financial document extraction: NLP processing financial filings, loan applications, earnings releases, and regulatory filings — extracting structured financial data (revenue, EBITDA, debt covenants, earnings guidance) from the varied formats of 10-K and 10-Q filings, analyst reports, and financial press releases. Investment teams at hedge funds and asset managers use financial document NLP to extract comparable data from thousands of filings that manual analysis couldn't process in the same timeframe.

Insurance and claims extraction: NLP processing insurance policy documents, claims submissions, and adjuster notes — extracting coverage details, claim amounts, incident descriptions, and loss type classifications from the unstructured text that insurance operations generate at high volumes.
Cost: $25,000–$75,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks

blocks.heading: Named Entity Recognition (NER)
paragraphs: Identifying and classifying specific entities in text — people, organizations, locations, dates, medical conditions, drug names, financial instruments:

Domain-specific NER training: General-purpose NER models (spaCy, BERT-based) perform poorly on domain-specific entities that aren't well-represented in their training data — the chemical compound names in pharmaceutical literature, the anatomical terms in clinical records, the jurisdiction-specific legal terms in regulatory filings. ClickMasters trains NER models on your domain's specific entity vocabulary.

Clinical NER: Extracting medical concepts from clinical notes — diagnoses (ICD-10 codes), medications (RxNorm), procedures (CPT codes), anatomical locations, and temporal relationships from the free-text clinical notes that contain the most complete clinical information but can't be queried by structured database approaches. Clinical NER enables population health analytics, quality measure extraction, and clinical research cohort identification from narrative clinical text.

Financial NER: Recognizing financial entities — company names, ticker symbols, financial product names, regulatory citations, and financial events — from financial news, analyst reports, and regulatory filings for financial intelligence applications.
Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Sentiment and Intent Classification
paragraphs: Understanding what text means beyond what it literally says:

Customer feedback sentiment: ML classifying customer reviews, support tickets, and survey responses by sentiment polarity, topic, and urgency — enabling customer experience teams to prioritize responses, identify product issues, and track sentiment trends across thousands of customer interactions without manual review.

Intent classification: NLP classifying incoming customer communications by the action they require — billing inquiry vs. technical support vs. return request vs. escalation — for customer service automation routing and self-service chatbot applications.

Regulatory sentiment: NLP analyzing regulatory filings, congressional testimony, and agency guidance for the sentiment signals that indicate regulatory risk direction for financial services and healthcare compliance teams.
Cost: $25,000–$65,000 | Timeline: 6–14 weeks

blocks.heading: Clinical NLP (Healthcare Specialist)
paragraphs: Clinical text presents unique NLP challenges — abbreviations, misspellings, institutional jargon, and implicit clinical reasoning that require healthcare-specific training:

Clinical note NLP: Extracting structured data from SOAP notes, discharge summaries, radiology reports, and pathology reports — the free-text clinical documentation that contains diagnostic reasoning, symptom evolution, and treatment response information that structured EHR fields don't capture. Clinical NLP enables quality measure extraction, clinical trial cohort identification, and retrospective research without manual chart review.

Radiology and pathology NLP: Structured finding extraction from radiology reports and pathology reports — converting the narrative reports that radiologists and pathologists write into structured data (finding present/absent, severity, laterality, comparison to prior) that can be queried and analyzed at population scale.

Medication reconciliation NLP: Extracting and reconciling medication lists from clinical notes, prescription records, and pharmacy data — a persistently challenging clinical task that NLP can automate with accuracy that approaches human reconciliation for standard medication vocabulary.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | HIPAA BAA standard

blocks.heading: Legal and Regulatory NLP
paragraphs: Legal text presents specific NLP challenges — defined terms, nested conditionals, cross-references, and the precision of language where small differences in phrasing have large consequences:

Contract analysis NLP: Automated contract review NLP that identifies high-risk clauses, unusual provisions, and missing standard protections across large contract portfolios — particularly valuable for M&A due diligence, supplier contract portfolios, and technology license reviews.

Regulatory compliance NLP: NLP monitoring regulatory publications (SEC releases, FDA guidance, CFTC advisories) for mentions of topics, companies, or regulatory positions relevant to an organization's compliance program — enabling compliance teams to track regulatory developments across the hundreds of publications that regulators issue annually.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Multilingual NLP
paragraphs: For organizations operating across language boundaries:

Spanish-English NLP: Bilingual document processing, sentiment analysis, and entity extraction for the US's large Spanish-speaking business and consumer community — with regional Spanish dialect awareness (Mexican Spanish, Puerto Rican Spanish, Cuban Spanish) that matters for consumer-facing NLP in specific US markets.

Cross-lingual information extraction: NLP extracting structured information from documents in multiple languages simultaneously — for global organizations that receive customer communications, legal documents, and regulatory filings in diverse languages.
Cost: $35,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

sections.title: ClickMasters' NLP Technology Stack
sections.description: Modern NLP infrastructure for production systems.

blocks.heading: Foundation models for NLP
paragraphs: GPT-4o extraction: For document extraction requiring complex reasoning — understanding conditional clauses in contracts, resolving pronouns across lengthy text, and handling multi-page documents with cross-references.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet: For long-document NLP tasks — Claude's 200K token context enables processing of full merger agreements, clinical records, and regulatory filings without chunking that loses cross-document context.
BERT variants (BioBERT, LegalBERT, FinBERT): Domain-specific BERT models for clinical, legal, and financial NLP where domain-specific pre-training improves accuracy on specialized terminology.

blocks.heading: Production NLP infrastructure
paragraphs: spaCy with custom trained pipeline components for production NLP at high volumes.
Hugging Face Transformers for model fine-tuning and inference.
FastAPI serving for production NLP APIs with request/response logging.
Apache Airflow for document processing pipeline orchestration.

items.question: What's the minimum NLP project budget?
items.answer: $25,000 for sentiment classification or simple extraction. Clinical and legal NLP with domain-specific training starts at $35,000.

items.question: How accurate is ClickMasters' clinical NLP?
items.answer: Clinical NLP accuracy depends heavily on the specific task, training data quality, and annotation quality. ClickMasters targets F1 scores above 0.90 for standard clinical entity types on held-out test data, with accuracy reporting as a standard deliverable.

items.question: How long does NLP development take?
items.answer: 6–20 weeks. Sentiment classification in 6–12 weeks; clinical NLP with annotation workflows in 12–20 weeks.

items.question: Can ClickMasters process Spanish-language documents?
items.answer: Yes — bilingual Spanish-English NLP with regional dialect awareness for US Spanish-speaking markets is standard.

items.question: Do NLP models need to be retrained as new documents arrive?
items.answer: ClickMasters implements continuous learning pipelines for production NLP — tracking accuracy on new documents, detecting vocabulary drift, and retraining on a schedule appropriate to your document corpus evolution.

items.question: Do we own the NLP models after delivery?
items.answer: Yes — complete IP transfer at project close including trained models, training data (where appropriate), and inference pipeline.
